title: 4th Day
categoryChain: Everyday short duas in the month of Ramadhan

verses.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ قَوِّنِيْ فِيْهِ عَلٰى اِقَامَةِ اَمْرِكَ،
verses.translation: O Allah, on this day, (please) grant me power so that I will carry out Your orders
make me taste the nice flavor of the reference to You,
arouse me to be thankful for You,through Your magnanimity,
and surround me with Your guarding and covering,
O best Seer of all those who can see!
